captions.detailed: An anamorphic camera taking lens consisting of a cylindrical outer main barrel, a rotating cylindrical front element for aligning the anamorphic squeeze, and a rotating rear cylindrical focus barrel. The lens is finished in a matte black color with white rectangular indicators aligned along the side of each section. The front element and the rear focus barrel are both connected to the main barrel via revolute joints, allowing them to rotate independently around the central optical axis.
captions.instruction: Generate an anamorphic camera taking lens with a cylindrical main barrel, a rotating front anamorphic alignment element, and a rotating rear focus barrel, all finished in matte black with white rectangular indicators. Ensure both the front and rear elements are connected to the central barrel via revolute joints rotating around the optical axis.
captions.factory: Construct three main cylindrical parts: a central main barrel, a front anamorphic barrel, and a rear focus barrel using cylinder primitives. Add small rectangular boxes as visual indicators on the side of each cylinder. Define two revolute joints (articulations) along the Z-axis (optical axis) connecting the front barrel to the main barrel, and the rear focus barrel to the main barrel, allowing independent rotational movement.
